title: Rafael and the Alibi
author: Sebastian Marchetti
blurb: Dominic Iversen, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
